name: T3 Code
desc: One app and phone remote for the agents already on your machine.
desc_zh: 把电脑上已有的编程 agent 收进一个应用，手机上也能接着批。
solves: Each coding agent sits in its own terminal and waits when you leave. T3 Code runs the agents you already have in one workspace, approvable from your phone.
solves_zh: 每个编程 agent 各占一个终端，人一走开就卡住。T3 Code 把你已装好的 agent 收进一个工作区，手机上也能批准下一步。
best_for: You juggle Claude Code, Codex and other agents and want one place to start, watch and approve their work.
best_for_zh: 你同时在用好几个编程 agent，想在同一个地方开任务、看进度、做批准。
notes: 首次公开发布取官方仓库最早的 GitHub Release（v0.0.0-alpha.3，2026-03-02）：https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/releases/tag/v0.0.0-alpha.3 。仓库创建于 2026-02-08；未找到官方发布公告，更早的桌面端下载时间未核实。源码解读基于提交 d00aaac85fc71195f133a8580c3f0f2e29ac33a2，MIT 许可。
